name: Generative Neural Feature Fields (GIRAFFE)
aliases: Generative Neural Feature Fields (GIRAFFE Object Representation)
definition: A method representing individual objects in a scene as separate neural feature fields, allowing for disentangled control of pose, shape, and appearance, unlike NeRF/GRAF which represent the entire scene with a single model.
summary: GIRAFFE is a scene representation framework that models individual objects using separate, compositional neural feature fields, enabling disentangled control over pose, shape, and appearance unlike monolithic models.
